status: CAD and publication-view update; not an acquisition or optical-performance validation
source_transform: translate optical center to XY origin and underside to Z=0; rotate +90 deg about Z; translate Z=122 mm

vendor_topology.note: The servo motor includes open vendor surface shells. They are preserved, not silently discarded or claimed printable.

optical_constraints.note: Raising the microscope is only a collision-free integration layout, not proof of preserved sample focus. Verify objective working distance before printing the large support.

remote_context.reason: Native UU terminal refused because another controller owns the device; no takeover performed.

hardware: 6x M6 breadboard screws and washers; use lengths suitable for the actual table
2x M5 x 20 socket screws and M5 nuts for foot-to-support joint
3x M6 x 25 socket screws and M6 nuts for stationary stage base
4x M6 x 10 low-head screws, head height <=4.5 mm, for rotating adapter
GT090101 side-lock screws clamp the four 5.9 mm printed locating pins; do not retain any rods joining it to the stationary sample stage
limitations: Proposed motorized apparatus layout; the earlier four-angle measurements did not use motorized rotation.
No firmware, raw measurements, reconstruction, Windows manuscript, stage motion or acquisition was changed.
Accepted relay geometry, lens seats, threads and optical datums are reused, not redesigned or optically recalibrated.
The existing microscope lift and objective-free gap are preserved; focus, conjugate planes and working distance remain unvalidated.
Frame/event camera bodies and existing interface/sample proxies are illustrative, not supplier-complete devices.
The rotary fixture remains a fit/clearance prototype requiring physical load, thermal, cable and fastening checks.
The lower-stack detail intentionally hides the rotary hardware and upper apparatus; it is not a literal crop or alternate physical assembly.

motor_yoke.locking_method: 2x M3 x 16 socket screws into captive real metal M3 nuts; screw/nut thread geometry is visualization-only, not a printed thread
motor_yoke.connector_note: Band X=91..103 is before the connector protrusions; bore, rotor, coupler and connector faces remain unrestrained.
motor_yoke.installation: Choose one lower yoke only: stand-foot version shares two M6 mounting holes; direct-table version sits outboard of the existing foot. The top bridge fits either.
motor_yoke.contact_note: Use optional thin compliant pads to take up the running clearance; close the bridge gently, do not crush the casing or preload the stage bearings.
motor_yoke.role: Secondary motor-end support/retention. Original three stationary-base mounting screws remain the primary support.

detector_contract.second_straight_port: accepted C12880MA holder and module proxies
